title: A shorter proof of the linear list Hadwiger conjecture
summary: The linear list Hadwiger conjecture asserts that every $K_t$-minor-free graph is $O(t)$-choosable. Following an approach outlined by Delcourt and Postle, we recently established $O(t\log\log t)$-choosability. Soon afterward, OpenAI provided a proof of the conjecture. A key new ingredient of their proof is a linear bound on the choice number of $K_t$-minor-free graphs with at most $t^{11/10}$ vertices. In this paper, we give a relatively simple proof of this small-graph bound for graphs with at most $t(\ln t)^5$ vertices.Combining this with the argument from our earlier $O(t\log\log t)$…
